Visitor replaces blockquote with custom format

```typescript title="TypeScript"

  const _testVisitor = {
    visitBlockquote(ctx: any, content: any, depth: any): string | { type: "custom"; output: string } {
        return { type: "custom", output: `QUOTE: "${content}"` };
```
